summary: Enforce ekodi.kr path-based URLs as the only human-facing EKODI service topology and prohibit service subdomains from being introduced, restored, or retained as user entry points.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly reaffirmed that EKODI no longer uses subdomains and instructed EKODI to make this a mandatory execution rule and complete the correction.
mandatoryRules: All human-facing services use https://ekodi.kr/{service} or an approved nested path.
Authentication return targets for human-facing services must resolve to https://ekodi.kr paths.
Service registries, admin navigation, manifests and UI must not advertise *.ekodi.kr service URLs.
Retired service subdomains must not be recreated as compatibility redirects without a new explicit owner approval.
New code and tests must reject reintroduction of human-facing service subdomains.
Infrastructure-only provider endpoints may remain only when they are not presented or used as EKODI human-facing service URLs and until replaced by apex-path/internal bindings.
migrationPolicy: Migrate incrementally through guarded branches and verification. Remove human-facing subdomain dependencies first, then retire infrastructure routes only after equivalent apex-path or internal binding health is verified.
rollbackPlan: Roll back a failing application release to the last verified apex-path artifact. Do not restore a retired human-facing service subdomain as the rollback mechanism.
